team: Week 1 done. Will wins on consistency with all 5 sessions logged, Fred wins Saturday with a 21:52 half sim to Will's 23:28 despite a banged up knee. Both need more run km next week.

fred.headline: Fast sim, but protect that knee
fred.summary: Four of five sessions logged: Mon, Tue, hockey and the half sim, with Friday swapped for a rest day after the hockey fall (knee 5 on Thursday, 4 on Friday, 0 on Saturday). Your half sim came in at 21:52 at RPE 9, but the 500 m runs went 2:42, 2:57, 3:48, 3:24, a 66 s spread, and you said it yourself: too hard on the SkiErg. Run volume was 4.4 of 8 km and average RPE was 7.8, high for a base week.
strengths: Strength work has headroom: hack squat 140 lb at RIR 3+ and all trap bar sets done
Sled push 1:22 for 24 m at 250 lb in the sim, solid for week 1
Smart call taking Friday off with knee pain at 4 instead of training through it
weaknesses: Run pacing: 66 s between your fastest and slowest 500 m, runs 3 and 4 at 7:36 and 6:48 per km
Sled pull 2:54 for 24 m was your slowest station by far
Knee pain hit 5 at hockey and 4 the day after; only 4.4 of 8 km run
tips: Pace the first 500 m at about 2:55 (1:25 goal pace is 5:53 per km) and keep all four within 15 s. Start the SkiErg at a pace you could hold for 1000 m.
Arms: you failed at rep 11 on lateral raises at 17.5 lb and rep 6 on curls at 27.5 lb. Hold laterals at 17.5 until you get 4 x 12, and drop curls to 25 lb to hit 3 x 10.

Knee: if it is above 3 at any point, stop that station and sub step ups or sled push. If it is still sore after the hockey fall next week, get it looked at, and book the MCL assessment before week 9 anyway.

tweaks.text: Knee check in the warm up: if it is above 3, keep hack squat at 140 lb and swap the EMOM lunges for step ups.
Run the first 500 m no faster than 2:55 and aim for all four runs within 15 s of each other.

will.headline: Perfect week, now add load
will.summary: All five sessions logged: Mon, Tue, hockey, Friday and the half sim, with knee pain never above 2. RPE averaged 5.4 and Monday was only RPE 3, so loads are still too light. Run volume was 5.4 of 8 km, and the sim total was 23:28 but the station splits were not timed (0:01 to 0:50), so your run splits of 5:12 to 6:19 likely include the stations.
strengths: Knee stayed at 0 to 2 all week, including hockey
DB bench 3 x 8 at 37.5 lb when the plan said 3 x 5, and you said you could go heavier
weaknesses: Loads too light: Monday was RPE 3 at 90 lb on trap bar and sled
Friday only 2 of 5 exercises: arms block B was skipped
Sim station splits not recorded and 5.4 of 8 km run
tips: In the sim, tap Start and Stop on each station so the splits are real. Then we can measure your run pacing and your stations separately.
Monday week 2 is hack squat 3 x 8 at RPE 7 after the trap bar, not RDL. RDL comes in week 9.
Do arms block B on Friday (face pulls 3 x 15, cable crunch 3 x 10). It takes 10 minutes and protects the shoulders for wall balls and the SkiErg.

tweaks.text: RPE 3 at 90 lb means go heavier: trap bar DL 3 x 5 at 100 lb and EMOM sled push at 110 lb.
Pull ups on the machine: keep the assistance at 70 lb (RIR 1), and DB bench 3 x 5 at 45 lb.
